facts.fact: Mediacongo reports that a technical validation workshop held in Kinshasa from 23 July and closed on 27 July 2026 by the digital economy ministry validated the draft national AI strategy (SNIA-RDC), subject to amendments, with World Bank support.

Nothing on government IT staff or systems.

facts.fact: Mediacongo reports that the digital economy ministry's validation workshop on the draft national AI strategy, closed on 27 July 2026, included the private sector, academia, civil society and technical partners alongside public institutions.
